SHRM 2022 starting point. Replacing it uses your assumption.
Demo assumption, not a legal entitlement.
Demo assumption, separate from recruiting.
Demo assumption.

Baseline = severance for the selected employees + recruiting and onboarding for available vacancies. A department closure excludes vacancies in that department. Employees in other departments are outside the selected scenario. Alternative = severance for employees without a proposed move + recruiting and onboarding for unfilled vacancies + training and administration for each proposed move.

Training quotes, durations, current salaries, vacancies and skill profiles are fictional assumptions. Training totals include course fees, supervised practice and AI tool access. Ongoing destination salaries are assumed equal for internal and external hires and excluded from both sides. Salary changes, payroll during training, vacancy losses, tax, legal fees and productivity gains are excluded. This is a transition cost estimate, not annual payroll savings. It assumes each proposed transfer succeeds; validate through a pilot.

Broader possibilities use a separate illustrative role library, including unapproved roles anticipated next month and role families without a vacancy. At least 2 of 4 listed skills must overlap and all gaps must have a modeled learning path. This is exploration only and is excluded from placements and costs.

Demo skill rule for current openings: at least 3 of 4 required skills, with any missing skill marked trainable. Each person gets at most one vacancy; each vacancy is used once. The model maximizes matched people within the time and training budget, then prefers more listed skills, shorter total training time and lower training cost. Equal plans use names and vacancy IDs for a stable demo tie break; a manager must review equal fits. No probability of success is implied.

Sources checked 21 October 2026. BLS customer service wage context: $44,770, May 2025 ↗. Individual demo salaries are assumed company salaries, not survey measurements.
